categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily focuses on the design, development, and sales of low-power wireless computing SoC chips. Key product lines include wireless audio chips, smart wearable chips, smart home chips, and wireless connectivity chips. These chips are widely applied in smart wearables such as TWS earbuds, smartwatches, smart glasses, and hearing aids, as well as in smart home devices like smart speakers and appliances.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include ultra-low power computing SoC integrating multi-core CPU, DSP, NPU, 2.5D GPU, and low-power display controllers. The company develops proprietary embedded AI co-processors (BECO), advanced Bluetooth and Wi-Fi 6 connectivity, adaptive ANC audio algorithms, and integrated RF front-end circuits. Manufacturing follows a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries and service providers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are global mainstream Android smartphone brands (Samsung, OPPO, Xiaomi, Honor, vivo), professional audio manufacturers (Harman, Anker, Edifier, Soundcore), internet companies (Alibaba, Baidu, ByteDance, Google), and home appliance manufacturers (Haier, Hisense, Gree). The main end markets are smart wearable devices and smart home IoT products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Shanghai and multiple R&D centers across Beijing, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Wuhan, Xi'an, and Hangzhou. It serves both domestic and international markets, with significant revenue from overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a fabless semiconductor design firm, focusing on upstream design and R&D. It outsources midstream wafer fabrication and downstream packaging and testing to third-party foundries and service providers, positioning itself primarily in the design and sales segment of the semiconductor supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in low-power wireless SoC platforms, expanding AI computing capabilities, advancing Bluetooth and Wi-Fi connectivity, and enhancing audio and sensor technologies. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on smart wearables and smart home applications, with ongoing projects in Bluetooth audio chip upgrades, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth dual-mode chips, smart glasses SoCs, smart watch SoCs, and low-power AIoT video platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales and distribution of SoC chips to brand customers and distributors. The company sells chips under both direct sales (to OEMs and module makers) and distribution models, recognizing revenue upon transfer of control to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the low-power wireless computing SoC market for smart wearables and smart home devices. It competes with international semiconductor firms with larger scale and broader product lines but maintains competitive advantages through advanced technology, strong brand customer relationships, and continuous innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 3.26 billion, a 49.94% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 460 million, a 272.47% increase. The company’s R&D investment reached RMB 617 million, representing 18.92% of revenue. The company has grown rapidly with expanding market share and improved profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes ultra-low power consumption combined with high computing performance in its SoC chips, integrating multi-core processors, AI accelerators, and advanced wireless connectivity. Its proprietary technologies in adaptive noise cancellation, multi-point Bluetooth connectivity, and integrated sensor capabilities provide differentiated user experiences in smart wearables and smart home devices. Strong brand partnerships and a comprehensive platform approach further differentiate its products.
